headline: US tech stocks tumble on AI cost worries and weak earnings
summary: US tech stocks fell sharply, with the Nasdaq opening at its lowest level in more than two months and Intel shares continuing to decline. Outlets describe a broader sell-off that built through the month and intensified after disappointing earnings from major tech companies, wiping out nearly $1tn in value as investors questioned whether heavy AI spending can generate returns quickly enough.
